title: Applebee's exposed customers' personal data after leaving database password in app | TechCrunch
summary: Applebee’s has fixed a security flaw that allowed anyone to access the personal information of its registered customers, after a researcher found a password for an internal database inside Applebee’s mobile app, TechCrunch has learned.
